release_notes: **Simulation Notes**: multi-day sim sessions now have a free-text notes field for recording parameter-setting observations when reviewing past tests. **Recorded strategy config**: each sim session now snapshots the strategy's full config as it was at launch (composer spec blocks, or flat params for script strategies), shown as a collapsed, human-readable breakdown — not a raw JSON dump — in both the results page and Reports → Sim History, so later live edits to the strategy don't retroactively change what a historical report shows. **Run time**: multi-day sim sessions now record and display how long the run took, in both the session list and the detail view. Adjustment rolls now apply to any position with a short SC/SP pair, not just structures with exactly two legs (e.g. iron condor's long wings are left untouched by the roll instead of blocking it entirely). Default strategy entry time moved from 9:45am to 10:00am. Multi-Day Sim's "Start" button now shows a spinner while the run is being launched, instead of the modal closing instantly with no feedback.
